shuffle.method: Fisher-Yates over the run files sorted by name, mulberry32 seeded with sha256(seed)[0:8]

extraction.records: normalised/case-a-pilot/<id>.json, written in the shuffled order above
extraction.input: the final assistant text blocks of response.content only; thinking, tool-use, search-result and code-execution blocks are not the answer and were ignored
rules: programmes: one entry per unit the run treats as a research programme in its own right, in order of presentation; programme_count counts those, an item ranked but never treated carries position null and is not counted

label: the run's own name, stripped of markdown, numbering and evaluative adjectives, head term plus at most three of its own parenthetical exemplars; never canonicalised onto a common vocabulary, never merged or split
verdict: one of the five scale values, or 'not stated' where the run gives none; a qualified or split verdict records its headline term, the qualification going to verdict_note in neutral prose

principal_problem: a short neutral noun phrase of at most fifteen words in the extractor's uniform prose; 'none' where the run says none, 'not stated' where it gives no such field; a closed-vocabulary label is never recorded on its own but expanded from the run's own reasoning for that programme

ranking: the labels of the final ranking, best to worst; where a run gives no separate ranked list but numbers its programmes and anchors that numbering as best to worst, the presentation order is the ranking

sources: every reference offered in support of a factual claim, in order of first appearance; a mention counts when it identifies a specific work — a title, a venue, an arXiv id, or an author or organisation plus a single publication year; bare instrument or collaboration names, bodies of work given only as a span of years, and series or data releases named without a year do not count

ref: as the run gave it, in the fixed form 'Author/Organisation, "Title", Venue, Year', keeping only the parts supplied; nothing added, nothing corrected, since existence and fidelity are what gets scored downstream
claim: the proposition the reference is made to support, in neutral uniform prose of at most twenty words, present tense, no evaluative adjectives
carried over: nothing else — no axis headings or axis text, no closing lines, no section structure, no arm-specific vocabulary, no verbatim quotation from the answer
extraction.residual_leak: a record whose verdicts are all 'not stated' is necessarily the bare arm, since the protocol mandates that value where the arm imposed no verdict field; blinding therefore separates the bare arm from the other two, and the B-to-C contrast stays blind
extraction.extractor: Claude Opus 5, working from the raw runs with the arm visible, applying the rules above uniformly and in shuffled order
